title: User Log Report
body:
### User Log Report

Sat, 30 Oct, 2021

[Articles](https://smart-hospital.in/articles)[Reports](https://smart-hospital.in/category/reports)

---

To check User Log report, go to **Reports > User Log Report**. Here select the **Time Duration** **and User Role** then click on**Search** button. Here you can see User Log details like **User, Role, IP Address, Login Time and User Agent** etc. Also you can download this report as PDF.
